proposal.reason: Primary change is reviewer/contribution automation: generating and publishing squash commit-message previews, adding authorized `/merge` handling, updating review/contribution skills/templates/docs, and wiring related GitHub Actions/scripts. `ci` is additionally needed because `pr-test-ppu.yml` changes independently alter CI orchestration behavior (new edited/manual metadata paths, concurrency grouping, and when `PCCL Tests Gate` is emitted) beyond purely mechanical caller updates.
